visualChecks: All22 images were regenerated from the same exact final main, decoder, widget and transport hashes; every accepted image was visually reviewed at native480x272.
Normal AOS5 fixture values22.8V/25.0A/2762mAh and6manual cells appear on Flight and Power. The current chart reports derived570W; labels, numbers, charts and actions fit.
Real numeric0 remains LIVE and plotted as0; missing Curr is SENSOR NOT FOUND; stale sources wait for live data; disabled voltage explains SOURCE DISABLED and the Sources action.
Qualified source lookups recover after late discovery without reopening; the separate Refresh action explicitly resets bindings and updates Power while keeping its page.

Sources opens Model Setup with Battery voltage selected and no edit active. Limits opens Model Battery. RTN twice returns to Power. The shared icon-only Arm control opens Arm Info and RTN restores Power.

All five battery favourites are reachable over two setting pages. Active Pack5 uses6cells/5000mAh with Capa2762 and no Bat% reading: remaining capacity is2238mAh, displayed as2.24Ah and estimated~45%.
Extreme values remain inside their rows/rails, and current/voltage graph labels do not overlap other content.
